[[File:LieutenantColonel.jpg|150px|thumb|An Imperial Lieutenant Colonel]]

The rank of '''Lieutenant Colonel''' was a rank used by a number of military hierarchies, including ground forces and some starfighter forces. Typically, it was placed between [[Major/Legends|Major]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the rank of Lieutenant Colonel was held by senior field officers among the non-clone troops attached to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], such as Colonel [[Ejai]] and Colonel [[Kreen]], the latter being the commander of an engineering [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]].

The rank of Lieutenant Colonel was relatively rare in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but the title was normally used in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] for the officers commanding [[Regiment/Legends|Regiments]] of up to 4,000 soldiers, as well as the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], also for officers commanding a regiment. It was also borne by some [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] officers, such as commando leader [[Palpatine Essex Yerac]] and [[Beryl Chiffonage]], the tactician who developed the "[[Attack Pattern Delta/Legends|Rogue Doctrine]]" for airspeeder tactics. Due to the often improvised nature of the Rebel military, however, there does not seem to be much consistency.

The rank became more common during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], however. It was the rank to which [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] officer [[Belindi Kalenda]] was demoted following the fake defection attempt of [[Elan]], and by the time that the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] was formed, it was held by many [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron leaders, including [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].

==Behind the scenes==
It hardly seems necessary to say that the rank of [[Wikipedia:Lieutenant_Colonel|Lieutenant Colonel]] (NATO Code OF-4) is common in real-world army and air force organizations. In ''Star Wars'', it appears in the section of the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' relating to the Army order-of-battle, but is otherwise rare in canon material until the [[New Jedi Order]] series.

Many novels, comics and RPG resources make no mention of Lieutenant Colonels, and add a rank of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] between [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]]. Although anomalous in terms of modern Anglo-American military, this corresponds, at least implicitly, to the system of the Napoleonic [[Wikipedia:Grande_Armee|''Grande Armée'']], in which ''major'' [http://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Major#France_.28Ancien_R.C3.A9gime.29 replaced] ''lieutenant-colonel''; following this model, it is possible that the rank of Major in ''Star Wars'' often denotes the equivalent of a real-world Lieutenant Colonel.
